summary_en: OKAMOTO INDUSTRIES authorized acquisition of up to 160,000 shares (0.94% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion from November 13, 2026 to September 30, 2027 via market purchase to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, OKAMOTO INDUSTRIES' board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock under the Companies Act Article 165, Paragraph 2. The company is authorized to acquire up to 160,000 shares (0.94% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate purchase price of ¥1.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from November 13, 2026 through September 30, 2027, to be conducted via open market purchase.

The company stated the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital allocation in the future. As of November 12, 2026, the company held 768,053 treasury shares against 16,931,314 issued shares excluding treasury stock. The authorization sets upper limits on both share quantity and aggregate purchase price; actual execution is not guaranteed and will depend on market conditions.
